title: Active set identification and rapid convergence for degenerate primal-dual problems
summary: Primal-dual methods for solving convex optimization problems with functional constraints often exhibit a distinct two-stage behavior. Initially, they converge towards a solution at a sublinear rate. Then, after a certain point, the method identifies the set of active constraints and the convergence enters a faster local linear regime. Theory characterizing this phenomenon spans over three decades.
